sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United face a demanding week with two fixtures. They travel to Stockport County on Tuesday 13 October in the Cheshire Senior Cup (a different-tier cup opponent), before returning to league action at home against Bilston Town on Saturday 17 October. Sandbach arrive in excellent form, having won four of their last five league games, and sit top of the table with 28 points from 12 games—but Bilston Town (third, 23 points) will provide a stern test on home soil.
divisionWide: The chasing pack faces several key fixtures. Second-placed Stafford Town host Brereton Social on Saturday, while third-placed Bilston Town travel to Sandbach after a midweek trip to face Bilston Town away on Wednesday. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host Telford Town on Saturday as they push the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (6th) host Market Drayton Town on Tuesday before away travel to Barnton on Saturday, with both sides looking to maintain momentum. Crewe travel to Widnes Town on Tuesday (20:00 KO), a fixture between struggling sides. Tuesday's midweek round includes Foley Meir hosting Cheadle Heath Nomads. On Saturday, Allscott Heath face Foley Meir at home, Eccleshall host Crewe, New Mills travel to Alsager Town, Shawbury United host Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Wednesfield Community are away at Market Drayton Town. Widnes Town face Dawley Town at home on Saturday. Barnton's strong recent run (four consecutive league wins) continues at home against AFC Bridgnorth.
